pictures.author: David Baron
pictures.observed: Full museum from road bridge. Long pointed curving metallic east gallery, flared tower cluster, high glazed atrium and sculptural overhanging canopy; flat limestone gallery wings. Art and independent bridge excluded.

pictures.author: Mariordo (Mario Roberto Duran Ortiz)
pictures.observed: Riverbank front elevation: descending pointed east gallery fins and curved lower metallic wall, stepped twisted central titanium volumes and glass roof lantern. Tall glass atrium beneath projecting metal canopy, long pale supporting column.

pictures.author: Xauxa (Hakan Svensson)
pictures.observed: Warm ashlar limestone masses, curved cylindrical front wall, tall angular glazed entry slot, curved descending stone treads and thin metal rails. Hidden stair count and exact levels are approximations.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Guggenheim Museum Bilbao: complete mapped asymmetric museum with long eastern fish-like gallery and pointed roof fins, clustered flared/leaning titanium lobes, 41m central lantern, tall river-facing glazed atrium and raised canopy, warm limestone south/west gallery ranges and curved entrance steps. Specific mapped parts guide plan/height; curved shell profiles, mullion inventory and hidden roofs are picture-led approximations. Independent La Salve bridge, surrounding buildings, promenade, pools and contemporary artworks are excluded.
